verdict.rationale: The pack has no documentation of bank-hosted OAuth for account linking, no list of OAuth institution coverage, and no plan for retiring credential-based flows. The bank-redirect evidence covers payment approval only, which is a different capability. A community comment says Belvo collects end users' online-banking credentials, but with no vendor claim to contradict, this is 'none' rather than 'disputed'.

support.subject: As a developer, connections to major institutions use bank-hosted OAuth rather than screen-scraped credentials — the platform documents its OAuth coverage and how legacy credential flows are being retired
